name: Sarah Smith
bioAdditions: Wife of Major Ebenezer Smith (1795-1879); daughter of Caleb Smith 2d (Pelletreau, S1), so herself a Bull Smith descendant: Bull -> Daniel -> Daniel 2d -> Caleb -> Caleb 2d -> Sarah (5 generations; 4C7R). Their sons were Ethelbert M. and Caleb T. Smith.

relationships.evidence: Pelletreau: Caleb Smith 2d's children include 'Sarah, wife of Ebenezer Smith, (son of Joshua, 2d)'

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. p. 477
sources.supports: Major Ebenezer Smith m. Sarah dau. of Caleb Smith 2d

researchLogEntry: Round 4: identified as daughter of Caleb Smith 2d (4C7R).
